evidence.title: Pryzm | Background & Visual Studio for Designers
Violets, a frosted glass floral background | Pryzm

name: Pryzm
summary: Browser studio for blending gradients, glass and grain into original backgrounds and animated loops.
description: A visual studio for designers: compose a look from three layers (gradient, glass, grain), style it with an effect stack that updates live, and export it in high resolution, save it, or share it as a link anyone can remix. An inspiration gallery of 42+ looks and a node-based Flow mode come with it. Free to create; Pro to export without limits.
contains: 42+ gallery looks to browse and remix
live effect stack, animation and node-based Flow mode
gallery filters: gradient, photographic, halftone, dither, ascii, glass, grain
export in high resolution, save it, or share a remix link
ships as code, not a video
free to create, Pro to export without limits
